checks: Practice starts with no task credit, phone ports shut and inline power disabled
Published IOS commands configure access VLAN 10, voice VLAN 20, PortFast, CDP, inline power and saved startup configuration
Policy tasks require actual unexpired CDP/LLDP-MED reception; switch configuration alone cannot pass
Phone leases require delivered server ACKs and both client/server lease records, correct /24, gateway and DNS
Tagged phone packets use VLAN 20 and CoS 5; PC passthrough retains the original MAC, untagged framing and IP TTL
Phone and PC dynamic MAC entries share each physical port in different VLANs
Wrong access/voice VLAN and PoE loss break the expected real traffic paths; repairs recover them
Missing discovery preserves PC data while phone policy/lease goals remain incomplete; restored delivery recovers voice
Static phone addresses cannot impersonate DHCP completion; malformed/executable imported criteria reject
Portable reload rebuilds policy, leases and MAC learning with stable device IDs and retained earned echo tasks
Existing runtime powers the phones; no registration, call-control, RTP or unimplemented telephony configuration added
